purpose: Context KB for pacs.002.001.10 FI To FI Payment Status Report V10 validation (CBPR+ SR2026). For each XML tag: possible errors, affected tags, and fix suggestions, plus ISO 20022 / CBPR+ formal rules.

iso_20022_rules.name: RelatedPresentWhenCopyDupl
iso_20022_rules.description: If CopyDuplicate is present, then Related MUST be present. Related MUST contain the relevant BusinessApplicationHeader elements of the BusinessMessage to which this BusinessMessage relates.

iso_20022_rules.name: GroupStatusAcceptedRule
iso_20022_rules.description: If OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus/GroupStatus is present and equals ACTC, ACCP, ACSP, ACSC or ACWC, then TransactionInformationAndStatus/TransactionStatus must be different from RJCT. NOTE: removed by CBPR+ guideline (OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus is removed).
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Invalid message content for group and transaction statuses.

iso_20022_rules.name: GroupStatusPendingRule
iso_20022_rules.description: If OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus/GroupStatus is present and equals PDNG, then TransactionInformationAndStatus/TransactionStatus must be different from RJCT. NOTE: removed by CBPR+ guideline.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Invalid message content for group and transaction statuses.

iso_20022_rules.name: GroupStatusRejectedRule
iso_20022_rules.description: If OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus/GroupStatus is present and equals RJCT, then TransactionInformationAndStatus/TransactionStatus, if present, must equal RJCT. NOTE: removed by CBPR+ guideline.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Invalid message content for group and transaction statuses.

iso_20022_rules.name: GroupStatusReceivedRule
iso_20022_rules.description: If OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus/GroupStatus is present and equals RCVD, then TransactionInformationAndStatus/TransactionStatus is not allowed. NOTE: removed by CBPR+ guideline.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Invalid message content for group and transaction statuses.

iso_20022_rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
iso_20022_rules.description: The SupplementaryData building block at message level must not be used to provide additional information about a transaction; the SupplementaryData element at transaction level should be used for that purpose. NOTE: removed by CBPR+ guideline (message-level SupplementaryData is removed).

iso_20022_rules.name: OriginalGroupInformationAbsenceRule
iso_20022_rules.description: If OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus is absent, then TransactionInformationAndStatus[*]/OriginalGroupInformation must be present. NOTE: removed by CBPR+ guideline.

iso_20022_rules.name: OriginalGroupInformationSinglePresenceRule
iso_20022_rules.description: If OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus is present and only once, then TransactionInformationAndStatus[*]/OriginalGroupInformation must be absent. NOTE: removed by CBPR+ guideline.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Invalid OriginalGroupInformation presence in transaction details.

iso_20022_rules.name: OriginalGroupInformationMultiplePresenceRule
iso_20022_rules.description: If OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus is present and multiple times, then TransactionInformationAndStatus[*]/OriginalGroupInformation must be present. NOTE: removed by CBPR+ guideline.

iso_20022_rules.name: StatusReasonRule
iso_20022_rules.description: If StatusReasonInformation/Reason/Code is equal to NARR, then AdditionalInformation must be present.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Invalid message content for additional status reason.

iso_20022_rules.name: BICFI
iso_20022_rules.description: Valid BICs for financial institutions are registered and published by the ISO 9362 Registration Authority and consist of eight (8) or eleven (11) contiguous characters.

iso_20022_rules.name: DuplicateIdentifierValue
iso_20022_rules.description: Identifiers required to be unique within a message (e.g. InstrId, TxId, EndToEndId, UETR) must not repeat across transactions or collide with GrpHdr/MsgId.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Identifier value is duplicated within the message.

iso_20022_rules.name: BicNotInDirectory
iso_20022_rules.description: Each BICFI should resolve to a registered institution in the official BIC directory.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: BIC/SWIFT code is not recognized in the official directory.

iso_20022_rules.name: MissingLeiAdvisory
iso_20022_rules.description: Under SR2026 a Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) is highly recommended for all financial institutions.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Agent FinInstnId is missing a recommended LEI.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules: AppHdr (BusinessApplicationHeaderV02) is mandatory for all CBPR+ messages and must precede the Document element.
AppHdr/Fr BIC must match TransactionInformationAndStatus/InstructingAgent BIC and AppHdr/To BIC must match TransactionInformationAndStatus/InstructedAgent BIC, except when CpyDplct = COPY or CODU.
AppHdr/Fr BIC must match TxInfAndSts/InstgAgt BIC and AppHdr/To BIC must match TxInfAndSts/InstdAgt BIC when CpyDplct is absent.
If TransactionInformationAndStatus/TransactionStatus is 'RJCT', then EffectiveInterbankSettlementDate (FctvIntrBkSttlmDt) is not allowed.
If TransactionInformationAndStatus/TransactionStatus equals 'RJCT', then at least one StatusReasonInformation/Reason must be present (mandatory).

If the transaction is exchanged on the SWIFT network (instructing agent/sender and instructed agent/receiver are on SWIFT), then BICFI is mandatory for InstgAgt and InstdAgt; other elements (e.g. LEI, ClrSysMmbId) are optional. For Instructing/Instructed Agents Name and PstlAdr are removed.

If BICFI is present inside FinInstnId, then Nm and PstlAdr are NOT allowed (ClearingSystemMemberIdentification and LEI may complement). In case of conflicting information, BICFI always takes precedence. If BICFI is absent, (Nm & PstlAdr) OR [(Nm & PstlAdr) and ClrSysMmbId] must be present; exception: when Debtor Agent, Creditor Agent and all agents in between are within the same country, the clearing code only may be used.
For StatusReasonInformation/Originator: if AnyBIC is absent, then Name is mandatory. If AnyBIC is present, it takes precedence in case of conflicting information.
For StatusReasonInformation/Originator: if PostalAddress is present then Name is mandatory.
OriginalInstructionIdentification must not start or end with a slash '/' and must not contain two consecutive slashes '//'. Pattern must not comply with '(/.*)|(.*/)|(.*//.*)'.
AppHdr/BizSvc must be 'swift.cbprplus.03' (SR2025). This element is mandatory (minimum occurrence changed to 1). Datatype changed to UsageIdentifierPatternText.
AppHdr/BizMsgIdr must equal GrpHdr/MsgId (the Message Identification of the underlying group header).
AppHdr/MsgDefIdr must be formatted exactly as it appears in the namespace of the Business Message instance, i.e. 'pacs.002.001.10'.
All proprietary/text fields (excl. Nm/Adr for all actors and RmtInf) limited to FIN-X charset. Nm/Adr/RmtInf and proxy email extended with !#$&%*=^_`{|}~";<>@[\] (< as <, > as >).

DateTime fields (CreDt, CreDtTm, OrgnlCreDtTm, FctvIntrBkSttlmDt/DtTm) must use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM format with a mandatory +/-HH:MM UTC offset. Z suffix is forbidden by the pattern '.*(\+|-)((0[0-9])|(1[0-4])):[0-5][0-9]'.
CBPR+ allows the status of one single transaction only per pacs.002 message. TransactionInformationAndStatus is made mandatory (min 1) and repeatability reduced to max 1.

The usage of pacs.002 to provide notification of a rejected (negative) status is required by all agents; usage to provide a positive status is always governed by bilateral agreement between the agents.
BranchIdentification is removed from InstgAgt and InstdAgt (group and transaction level), AppHdr Fr/To agents, Related Fr/To agents, and ChrgsInf/Agt under CBPR+ SR2025.

Removed under CBPR+ SR2025: AppHdr/BizPrcgDt, AppHdr/Sgntr, GrpHdr/InstgAgt, GrpHdr/InstdAgt, OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus (message level), message-level SupplementaryData, TxInfAndSts/StatusIdentification, TxInfAndSts/ChargesInformation, TxInfAndSts/AcceptanceDateTime, TxInfAndSts/AccountServicerReference.
BAH "To" BIC must match "Instructed Agent" BIC, except where BAH CopyDuplicate = COPY or = CODU
BAH "To" BIC must match "Instructed Agent" BIC if CopyDuplicate is absent.
The Business Message Identifier must match the Message Identification in the Group Header.
BAH "From" BIC must match "Instructing Agent" BIC
If used, the Related BAH must transport the exact same information as in the BAH of the related message.

The Business Message Identifier is the unique identifier of the Business Message instance that is being transported with this header, as defined by the sending application or system. Must contain the Message Identification element from the Group Header of the underlying message, where available (as is typically the case with pacs, pain, and camt messages, for example). If Message Identification is not available in the underlying message, then this element must contain the unique identifier of the Business Message instance.

The Message Definition Identifier of the Business Message instance that is being transported with this header. In general, it must be formatted exactly as it appears in the namespace of the Business Message instance.
If related BAH is present, it should transport the element Business Service.
If TransactionStatus/Code equals RJCT, then “Status Reason Information/Reason” is mandatory.
If TransactionStatus is “RJCT’ then Effective Interbank Settlement Date is not allowed.
Original Message Identification must transport the Message Identification of the underlying payment (e.g. pacs.008/pacs.009/pacs.004).
This element must be populated with either pacs.008.001.xx, pacs.009.001.xx, pacs.004.001.xx, pacs.003.001.xx or pacs.010.001.xx.
Should transport the Instruction Identification of the underlying payment message for example pacs.008/pacs.009 or the same Original Instruction Identification if present in pacs.004.
This element must not start or end with a slash '/' and must not contain two consecutive slashes '//'.
Should transport the EndToEnd Identification of the underlying payment message for example pacs.008/pacs.009 or the same Original EndToEnd Identification as in the pacs.004.
Should transport the Transaction Identification of the underlying payment message for example pacs.008/pacs.009 when present, or the same Original Transaction Identification if present in pacs.004
Must transport the UETR of the underlying pacs.008/pacs.009.
If AnyBIC is present, in addition to any other optional elements, in case of conflicting information it will always take precedence.
If Postal Address is present then Name is mandatory. Recommendation: If present, the BIC (AnyBIC) will always take precedence in case of conflicting information.
If AnyBIC is absent, then Name is mandatory.
Data present in structured elements within the Postal Address must not, under any circumstances be repeated in AddressLine.
